name: system
comment: system(cmd) — MATLAB-compatible process spawn. Sig: [status, cmdout] = system(cmd); single output returns status. Fingerprint is the exit code only (s=0 for echo); cmdout is shell-dependent and not fingerprinted (trailing newline / encoding differences across cmd.exe vs sh make exact comparison brittle). iters=1 — no point repeating a process spawn. coder / coder_run / runNative are numkit-native (no MATLAB equivalent) — not parity-spec'd.
